- J6 Conn_01x04 M5Unit PortB breakout (GND,+5V,two GPIOs), passed through from J1/J2.
- J7 Conn_01x02 5V_POWER external 5V.
- D1 SS54 series diode between J7 external 5V in and board +5V rail blocks backfeed.
- D2 PMEG3030EP diode from +5V into servo power rail feeding J3/J8 pin2 and C1-C4.
- C1-C4 100uF bulk servo rail.
- C5 0.1uF decoupling +3V3 MAX3485 supply.
- Q1 IRLML6402 P-MOSFET high-side battery disconnect gates J5 onto /BAT bus net.
- SW1 SPDT switch optional power switch; pulls Q1 gate low via R5 47k to turn battery path on.
- Q2 BC857 PNP auto TX/RX direction control driven from /TXD2 via R1 10k, R2 5.1k to toggle MAX3485 DE/RE enable pins.
- U1 MAX3485 transceiver converts UART TXD2/RXD2 to shared TTL serial servo bus.
- R1,R2 10k,5.1k bias/divider from /TXD2 into Q2 base.
- R6,R7,R8,R15 2k,20k,2.2k,2.2k bias/pull network on MAX3485 A/B differential lines and DE/RE enable line.
- R3,R4 1k each series resistors from PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin3/J8 pin3 respectively.
- R9-R12 0Ω jumpers select which M5Stack bus pin (pin19/21 for ch1, pin20/22 for ch2) supplies PWM1/PWM2.
- R13,R14 0Ω jumpers when shorted bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto MAX3485 TTL bus.
